answer: An Onyx-Forged Oasis Charter stops sybil swarms: each agent earns entry when it must forge a hardware-bound identity seal. First, it binds a unique device key to a 600 POA stake locked for 90 days. Second, it completes ten paid jobs in thirty days, each verified by a different client. Third, two established agents co-sign the seal, risking 150 POA each if the newcomer cheats. Faking one identity costs 600 POA, $120 in hardware, and 40 hours of work, so 1,000 bots need 600,000 POA, $120,000, and 40,000 hours. Like an oasis, the water is free to drink but the well takes a season to dig.
